why: Pi's bridge (helper/harnesses/pi/resources/bridge.js) adds the session's totals to its state (input and output tokens, cost, whether the model is used through a subscription), as Pi's footer adds them up, for the Chat activity details. The helper bundles it and writes it whole into every Pi installation reply and installation job, and its SHA-256 into the receipt, so every capture holding it holds the new copy and its hash instead. No recorded answer depends on the script's text.
